title: Computational identification of novel signature of T2DM-induced nephropathy and therapeutic bioactive compounds from Azanza garckeana.
authors: Lawal, Bashir; Kuo, Yu-Cheng; Onikanni, Sunday Amos; Chen, Yi-Fong; Abdulrasheed-Adeleke, Tawakaltu; Fadaka, Adewale Oluwaseun; Olugbodi, Janet O; Lukman, Halimat Yusuf; Olawale, Femi; Mahmoud, Mohamed H; Batiha, Gaber El-Saber; Wu, Alexander Th; Huang, Hsu-Shan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过RNA测序识别糖尿病肾病基因签名，并对植物化合物与SOX4/SOX9等转录因子靶点做分子对接和100ns动态模拟，虽涉及TF-DNA相关靶点与MD方法，但核心是疾病生物标志物和药物筛选，非TF-DNA互作机制研究。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Diabetic nephropathy (DN) is one of the most prevalent secondary complications associated with diabetes mellitus. Decades of research have implicated multiple pathways in the etiology and pathophysiology of diabetic nephropathy. There has been no reliable predictive biomarkers for the onset or progression of DN and no successful treatments are available. METHODS: In the present study, we explored the datasets of RNA sequencing data from patients with Type II diabetes mellitus (T2DM)-induced nephropathy to identify a novel gene signature. We explored the target bioactive compounds identified from Azanza garckeana, a medicinal plant commonly used by the traditional treatment of diabetes nephropathy. RESULTS: Our analysis identified lymphotoxin beta (LTB), SRY-box transcription factor 4 (SOX4), SOX9, and WAP four-disulfide core domain protein 2 (WFDC2) as novel signatures of T2DM-induced nephropathy. Additional analysis revealed the pathological involvement of the signature in cell-cell adhesion, immune, and inflammatory responses during diabetic nephropathy. Molecular docking and dynamic simulation at 100 ns conducted studies revealed that among the three compounds, Terpinen-4-ol exhibited higher binding efficacies (binding energies (DeltaG) = -3.9~5.5 kcal/mol) against the targets. The targets, SOX4, and SOX9 demonstrated higher druggability towards the three compounds. WFDC2 was the least attractive target for the compounds. CONCLUSION: The present study was relevant in the diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment follow up of patients with diabetes induced nephropathy. The study provided an insight into the therapeutic application of the bioactive principles from Azanza garckeana. Continued follow-up invitro validations study are ongoing in our laboratory.
abstract_zh: 目的：糖尿病肾病（DN）是糖尿病最常见的继发性并发症之一。数十年的研究已涉及多条与糖尿病肾病病因和病理生理学相关的通路。目前尚无可靠的预测性生物标志物用于DN的发生或进展，也缺乏有效的治疗方法。方法：在本研究中，我们探索了来自II型糖尿病（T2DM）诱导肾病患者的RNA测序数据集，以识别新的基因特征。我们进一步探究了从药用植物Azanza garckeana中鉴定出的靶向生物活性化合物，该植物常用于传统治疗糖尿病肾病。结果：我们的分析将淋巴毒素β（LTB）、SRY-box转录因子4（SOX4）、SOX9和WAP四二硫化物核心域蛋白2（WFDC2）鉴定为T2DM诱导肾病的新特征。进一步分析揭示了这些特征在糖尿病肾病期间参与细胞-细胞粘附、免疫和炎症反应的病理作用。通过分子对接和100 ns动态模拟研究，发现在三种化合物中，Terpinen-4-ol对靶标表现出更高的结合效能（结合能（DeltaG）= -3.9~5.5 kcal/mol）。靶标SOX4和SOX9对这三种化合物显示出更高的可成药性。WFDC2是这些化合物最不具吸引力的靶标。结论：本研究对糖尿病肾病患者的诊断、预后和治疗随访具有相关性。该研究为Azanza garckeana中生物活性成分的治疗应用提供了见解。我们实验室正在持续进行体外验证研究的后续工作。
